registered: 2026-09-30, before any v3 full-scale result existed (commit recorded in git history)
question: Does per-primitive detectability at a fixed 1% alert capacity follow the action family (P1/P2/P3) or whether the edit leaves a checkable contradiction inside the message?
definition: contradiction-bearing = the edit makes two elements of the same message, or an element and the creditor's static industry profile, inconsistent with each other; coherent = the edit removes, relocates, reroutes or decomposes information without creating such an inconsistency

P1a.rationale: relocates the ultimate-party name into remittance text; the message stays internally consistent, an element is merely absent

P1b.rationale: the free-text address line carries the true town while the structured TwnNm names a different town

P1c.rationale: a short name is not inconsistent with anything else in the message

P2a.rationale: a salary code for a creditor whose industry profile rarely or never receives salary payments

P2b.rationale: category purpose SALA against a purpose code and narrative that describe goods or services

P2d.rationale: salary code over a goods, invoice or shipment narrative

P3a.rationale: same payment on another path; each message is internally coherent

P3c.rationale: a plausible intermediary replaces the ultimate party; nothing in the message contradicts it

primary_outcome: per-primitive recovery at the frozen 1% threshold on the test window, mean over the ten main seeds, for D2 (supervised on raw features that contain no hand-built consistency check) and D5 (label-free LOF on the feature vector); D1 is reported as a reference only because its rules are the contradiction checks themselves
tests: exact permutation tests over all relabellings (330 for the binary label, 11550 for the family multiset), variance explained R^2, difference in mean recovery, and leave-one-primitive-out prediction error of each grouping
external_rating: analysis/EXPERT_QUESTIONNAIRE.md is prepared for two or three blinded domain raters; their labels, once collected, replace these and the test is rerun unchanged
